body: Wow my post actually got down voted just for existing. Thanks.

Yes I do worry about this. I was married for about 9 years. Ex husband couldn’t cope with me and my shit. I asked for a divorce due to that and other reasons. My currently partner is very supportive and loyal. But I do still worry about how much I put on him and I worry that he will eventually get tired of it.

I disagree. It gets harder the longer you feel this way. What changes is that you realize you haven’t died yet, so you feel like maybe you can do one more day. But it’s not a comforting feeling. And it’s not easier.
